title: Pink Gingham Baby Shower
description: An outdoor shower under a white marquee. Pink gingham cloths run the length of the tables with galvanised tins of baby’s breath spaced down the middle, and a clothesline of tiny outfits and cow-print bunting is strung overhead. Each cover gets a printed activity card, a favour, and a copper charger.
